subject: Conference follow-up: Inference needs & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@fintechx.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Great meeting at AI Inference Summit — quick follow-up

Hi Elena —

It was great to meet you at the AI Inference Summit last week. Really enjoyed our conversation about FinTechX's plans to move more of the fraud-detection pipeline to low-latency LLM inference (especially the risk scoring use case you mentioned). A quick recap and suggested next steps: 

- Key needs you called out: 1) sub-100ms tail latency for short prompts, 2) predictable unit cost at scale, and 3) SOC 2 + auditability for transaction logs.
- Redwood fit: Hosted API for quick POC, Dedicated pools for predictable throughput, Private deployment (VPC) for regulated data + KMS support.

Next steps I suggest:
1) 30–45 min discovery call to map your throughput/latency targets and current model stack (open-source vs. internal).
2) Share a mutual action plan (MAP) so we can align on milestones for a Q4 POC.

I’ve attached a one-pager and our SOC2 summary for your security team to skim.

Are you available for a call next week (Sept 15–17)? If helpful I can include our SE, Lauren, on the call.

Thanks again — it was a pleasure meeting you in person.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0142

Attachments: redwood-inference-one-pager.pdf, SOC2-summary-2026.pdf

From: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@fintechx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Great meeting at AI Inference Summit — quick follow-up

Hi Marissa —

Really good to meet you as well — thanks for the clear recap. The three needs you listed are spot on. I’d love a discovery call to go through our latency targets and current infra.

Sept 15 at 10am PT works on my side. I’ll loop in Emily (procurement) if we get to contract/PO conversations. Can Lauren join to talk about model/quantization options?

Thanks,
Elena
Head of ML Ops, FinTechX
elena.gomez@fintechx.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@fintechx.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Emily Hart <emily.hart@fintechx.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T08:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Great meeting at AI Inference Summit — discovery + MAP attached

Thanks Elena — confirmed for 9/15 10:00am PT. Meeting invite is on its way.

Quick prep for the call — attached is a lightweight MAP template I mentioned and a short one-pager for the evaluation options. On the call we’ll look to capture:

- Current QPS and peak burst characteristics
- Typical prompt/sequence length distribution (median + 95th pct)
- Success criteria for POC (latency SLA, cost per 1M tokens, throughput)
- Security/compliance checkpoints (SOC2 artifacts, KMS/HSM, retention windows)

Lauren will run through model tradeoffs (quantization, batching) and Marcus will listen for procurement constraints so we can sketch a pricing/commitment that makes sense.

If you have any quick docs (traffic numbers or a current infra diagram) please drop them into the MAP link before the call: https://drive.google.com/fintechx/mutual-action-plan

Looking forward —
Marissa

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-template.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@fintechx.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T11:16:00-07:00
Subject: Checking in — MAP/next steps for FinTechX POC

Hi Elena —

Wanted to bump this thread in case it got buried — did you have a chance to review the MAP and the SOC2 one-pager I sent? We didn’t see the traffic doc come through, so if priorities shifted I’m happy to adjust the plan (shorter POC, focused benchmark, or a hosted API start). 

If now isn’t the right timing, could you let me know if this is still a priority for Q4? If it’s helpful, we can also propose a short benchmark: 1) 1k QPS baseline test on Dedicated pool, 2) latency tail report, and 3) cost estimate for 1M tokens.

Quick thumbs:
- Still priority for Q4? (yes / push to Q1 / not a focus)
- Would procurement (Emily) like a separate convo on contract terms?

Thanks for the nudge back — and happy to hop on a 15-min call this week if easier.

Best,
Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@fintechx.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up — still aligned?

Hi Elena —

Circling back one last time this week — if this is on your roadmap for Q4 we can reserve a small Dedicated pool for a short eval and keep costs contained for an initial benchmark. If now isn’t right, would you mind a short note saying when might be better? Even a month range helps us schedule SE time.

If helpful, I can also send a 1-page scope we’d run as the POC (objectives, success metrics, timeline).

Appreciate it —
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
